title: Exact fault images in priority controllers
summary: Exact reachable qualifier-set images for a finite priority controller with independent enable and request inputs and a specified first-stage bridge interface. The formal statements characterize detection through arbitrary Boolean qualifier observations, show that nonemptiness cannot be expressed by valid proper-coordinate relations, and classify a specified qualifier-only stuck-at fault. The selector and fault equations are explicit.

formalizes.title: Polynomial Fault Detection Without Bounded Width: Exact Reachable Sets in Priority Controllers

review.reason: Characterizes exact reachable qualifier images and fault detection for a priority controller.
